import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem mathd_algebra_214_strictMono_right
  (a b c : ℝ)
  (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (h₀ : ∀ x, f x = a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c)
  (h₁ : IsExtrOn f Set.univ 2)
  (h₂ : f 2 = 3)
  (h₃ : f 4 = 4) :
  ∀ x y : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → x < y → f x < f y := by
  have hf : ∀ x, f x = a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c := h₀
  have hf2_eq : a * (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 + b * 2 + c = 3 := by
    have h := hf 2
    linarith [h₂]
  have hf4_eq : a * (4 : ℝ) ^ 2 + b * 4 + c = 4 := by
    have h := hf 4
    linarith [h₃]
  have h_min : IsMinOn f Set.univ 2 := by
    rcases h₁ with hmin | hmax
    · exact hmin
    · exfalso
      have hle : f 4 ≤ f 2 := hmax (Set.mem_univ 4)
      linarith [h₂, h₃]
  have ha_ne : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha0
    have hb : b = 1 / 2 := by
      have h1 := hf 2
      have h2 := hf 4
      rw [ha0] at h1 h2
      nlinarith
    have hc : c = 2 := by nlinarith [hf 2, h₂, ha0, hb]
    have hf0 : f 0 = c := by
      have h := hf 0
      rw [ha0] at h
      simp at h
      linarith
    have hle : f 2 ≤ f 0 := h_min (Set.mem_univ 0)
    linarith [h₂, hf0, hc]
  have ha_pos : 0 < a := by
    by_contra h_not_pos
    push_neg at h_not_pos
    have ha_neg : a < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne h_not_pos ha_ne
    have ha_ne' : a ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt ha_neg
    let y := max (2 : ℝ) (-b / a - 2) + 1
    have hy_gt2 : 2 < y := by
      have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ max (2 : ℝ) (-b / a - 2) := le_max_left _ _
      unfold y
      linarith
    have hle : f 2 ≤ f y := h_min (Set.mem_univ y)
    have hfy : f y = a * y ^ 2 + b * y + c := hf y
    have hf2 : f 2 = a * 2 ^ 2 + b * 2 + c := hf 2
    have h_diff : f y - f 2 = (y - 2) * (a * (y + 2) + b) := by nlinarith
    have h_y_sub_pos : 0 < y - 2 := by linarith
    have h_a_y_b_neg : a * (y + 2) + b < 0 := by
      by_cases hle_max : (2 : ℝ) ≤ -b / a - 2
      · have hmax_eq : max (2 : ℝ) (-b / a - 2) = -b / a - 2 := max_eq_right hle_max
        have hy_eq : y = -b / a - 2 + 1 := by
          show max (2 : ℝ) (-b / a - 2) + 1 = _
          rw [hmax_eq]
        rw [hy_eq]
        have h1 : a * (-b / a - 2 + 1 + 2) + b = a := by
          field_simp
          ring
        linarith
      · push_neg at hle_max
        have hmax_eq : max (2 : ℝ) (-b / a - 2) = 2 := max_eq_left (le_of_lt hle_max)
        have hy_eq : y = 3 := by
          show max (2 : ℝ) (-b / a - 2) + 1 = _
          rw [hmax_eq]
          norm_num
        rw [hy_eq]
        have h_div_lt : -b / a < 4 := by linarith
        have h_b_lt : b < -4 * a := by
          have h1 : -b / a < 4 := h_div_lt
          rw [div_lt_iff_of_neg ha_neg] at h1
          linarith
        nlinarith
    have h_prod_neg : (y - 2) * (a * (y + 2) + b) < 0 :=
      mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg h_y_sub_pos h_a_y_b_neg
    linarith
  have hb_eq : b = -4 * a := by
    by_contra hb_ne
    let y0 := -b / (2 * a)
    have ha_ne0 : a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ha_pos
    have h2a_ne : (2 : ℝ) * a ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply ha_ne0
      nlinarith
    have hb_y0 : b = -2 * a * y0 := by
      show b = -2 * a * (-b / (2 * a))
      field_simp
    have hfy0 : f y0 = a * y0 ^ 2 + b * y0 + c := hf y0
    have hf2 : f 2 = a * 2 ^ 2 + b * 2 + c := hf 2
    have h_diff : f 2 - f y0 = a * (2 - y0) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [hb_y0]
    have hy0_ne : y0 ≠ 2 := by
      intro heq
      have : b = -4 * a := by
        rw [heq] at hb_y0
        linarith
      exact hb_ne this
    have h_sq_pos : 0 < (2 - y0) ^ 2 := by
      apply sq_pos_of_ne_zero
      intro h
      apply hy0_ne
      linarith
    have h_pos : 0 < a * (2 - y0) ^ 2 := mul_pos ha_pos h_sq_pos
    have h_lt : f y0 < f 2 := by linarith
    have hle : f 2 ≤ f y0 := h_min (Set.mem_univ y0)
    linarith
  have ha_val : a = 1 / 4 := by nlinarith
  have hb_val : b = -1 := by nlinarith
  have hc_val : c = 4 := by nlinarith
  have hf_form : ∀ x, f x = a * (x - 2) ^ 2 + 3 := by
    intro x
    have hx := hf x
    have h1 : b = -4 * a := hb_eq
    have h2 : c = 3 + 4 * a := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  intro x y hx hxy
  have hfx : f x = a * (x - 2) ^ 2 + 3 := hf_form x
  have hfy : f y = a * (y - 2) ^ 2 + 3 := hf_form y
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x - 2 := by linarith
  have hxy0 : x - 2 < y - 2 := by linarith
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y - 2 := by linarith
  have h_sq_lt : (x - 2) ^ 2 < (y - 2) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 2), sq_nonneg (y - 2), sq_nonneg (y - x)]
  have h_a_sq_lt : a * (x - 2) ^ 2 < a * (y - 2) ^ 2 :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_sq_lt ha_pos
  linarith
